description: Lists the real devices available on TestMu AI for mobile app testing, 50 per page by default. Filter by region, OS, device name or OS version, and page with limit and offset. The text gives the total that matched.

deviceName.description: Device name to match, case-insensitively as a substring, e.g. "Galaxy S24", "iPhone 15", "Pixel"

platformVersion.description: OS version to match, e.g. "14" (matches 14 and 14.x)

name: listDevicesForTesting
title: List Devices for Testing
